title: Missingness pattern
caption: Seed-42 uniform TRAIN display. Full released-data audit: 0 conventional missing cells across all seven variables. The 62 paired zeros remain observations, not confirmed missing values.

title: Target class distribution
caption: All TRAIN labels, without rebalancing. Counts and percentages expose rare hardware states; accuracy alone is inadequate. Class 4 is natural building shade, not hardware failure.

title: Raw vs reference-cleaned boxplots
caption: Full TRAIN IQR box statistics and fliers are shown. Reference cleaning is the existing RetainedQuality policy; unusual values remain. Nearly identical panels reflect intentional retention, not failed cleaning. Units are channel-specific.

title: Training predictor correlation
caption: All six raw TRAIN predictors; f_nv is excluded. Asterisks mark |r| >= 0.85 (five pairs), matching Phase 1. Screening warns about redundancy; the frozen reference retains physical channels pending the predeclared ablation, rather than automatically dropping them.

title: Collinear predictor pairs
caption: All five Phase 1 high-correlation pairs. Points are a uniform seed-42 TRAIN sample; correlations and descriptive OLS lines use full TRAIN. Association is not causation; dependence precludes naive significance claims.

title: Feature-target mutual information
caption: Seed-42 proportional stratified TRAIN sample, k=3 continuous-feature MI estimator; train-fitted standardization. Target codes remain nominal. This descriptive diagnostic does not alter frozen model/feature choices; imbalance, repeated readings and ties limit interpretation.

title: Transformation/scaling comparison
caption: All learned scaler parameters use full TRAIN. Scaling changes units, not the underlying skewed shape. StandardScaler aligns LR regularization; RF/LightGBM retain native scale. Robust/MinMax are diagnostic alternatives only. Optional log1p is not introduced into frozen pipelines.

title: PCA scree and cumulative variance
caption: StandardScaler and full-SVD PCA are fitted to full TRAIN only. PCA is an exploratory mathematical diagnostic, not physical sensor reduction, a feature-selection rule, or a change to the frozen models. All six inputs are needed to compute the components.
